title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, public policy, messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Persons observe peers in their social network and update adoption propensity based on neighbors' mask use and perceived social norms.

interactions.name: location_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask requirements, influencing Person compliance via admission rules and perceived enforcement risk.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: PolicyMaker sets mandates and enforcement probability; Persons may face fines or increased compliance pressure.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks from Retailers subject to stock, price, and rationing policies.

interactions.name: public_messaging
interactions.description: PolicyMakers and MediaOutlets broadcast messages affecting risk perception, perceived efficacy, and trust-driven adoption.

interactions.name: context_feedback
interactions.description: Environment signals (e.g., disease prevalence) update Person risk perception and can trigger policy adjustments.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach 50% mask adoption.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_after_policy_end
metrics.description: Average adoption rate for a window after mandates end.

metrics.name: group_adoption_disparity
metrics.description: Difference or inequality index in adoption across demographic or socioeconomic groups.

metrics.name: policy_lift
metrics.description: Increase in adoption attributable to policy versus a counterfactual without policy.

metrics.name: stockout_days
metrics.description: Number of days with mask shortages at retailers.

metrics.name: average_fines_per_capita
metrics.description: Mean fines issued per person over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: location_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of entrants to mask-required locations who are compliant.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate must remain within [0, 1] at all times.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_check
validation_criteria.description: Simulation considered converged when the absolute change in adoption rate < 0.005 for 7 consecutive days.

validation_criteria.name: nonnegative_inventory
validation_criteria.description: Retailer stock levels must not be negative at any time step.

validation_criteria.name: reproducibility
validation_criteria.description: With a fixed random seed, summary metrics should match baseline within 1% relative tolerance.

validation_criteria.name: no_spurious_effects
validation_criteria.description: With all influence weights set to zero, adoption should not change from the initial adoption rate.
